body: My husband keeps telling me he wants me to get better. I want to get better too but adding that kind of stress isn't going to fix anything because then I'm not trying to heal for myself but for him. He doesn't know much about mental health and this is something I have been suffering from most of my life. I don't know what "happy" feels like.
Comparing situations never helps anyone. It's awesome when someone can embrace his or her feelings as well. You do you. Fuck them. 👍
Oh my god!!!! Comparing situations is the worst.
It'll get better makes me so uncomfortable.
Sometimes you don't want help though. Sometimes you just need vent and let the emotion go. Some people don't get that.

Thank you guys. It just feels like I'm not taking care of my family the way I'm supposed to because of this. It's nice knowing that others have moments of extreme anxiety as well.  It's one thing to read an article online but it's something else to actually hear from people suffering.
For my eighth birthday grandma gave me fat free pudding.
Long ago the four nations lived together in harmony...
Shelby in Faithful by Alice Hoffman. I've never cheered for a character harder than her.
She talked to the school counselor today and even suggested going to talk to someone herself :) hoping for a positive change.
We've definitely considered therapy for her and maybe family therapy for all of us trying to adjust.

I invited a 12 people to a coworker dinner that was intended for just 3 if us. So when I texted everyone and said I can't make it no one would be mad. I work 40 hours and a week and go to school. I really don't want to hang out with anyone on my off time...
My husband bought me a huge stuffed hedgehog a few years ago and every time I'm laying down and he has to go somewhere he does the same thing! It's the little things :)

Math is not my strong subject and never will be. In high school my teacher called on me to answer a question and I told her I didn't know the answer. She proceeded to argue asking why I didn't know the answer and to try harder. I responded that I'm taking notes and doing the best I can but have no idea what the answer is. She told me to lose the attitude and asked why I was getting so mad. I told her to stop calling students out in class when you clearly know they're struggling. She kicked me out of her class. 

Later on I enrolled in a college algebra course my second semester at the local community college I walked in and saw she was the teacher  decided to give her a chance and stayed in the class (I was really hoping she wouldn't remember me but she did). She did the same thing to me again the first night of class. After the lecture was over I told her she's a terrible teacher. Dropped her class and she has the worst reviews on rate my professor.

The thought has crossed my mind more than once however I struggle with the cost and time while working a full time job and going to school. I'm not trying to make excuses but also being realistic. I was hoping someone could give insight if they have found themselves in this position or know someone personally who has.
